title: REQUEST:  an additional widget that uses a much larger font
symptom: The user requests a widget with a much larger font for displaying blood glucose values, as the font does not enlarge when the widget size is increased. The user also mentions an Android Notifications issue that prevents installing newer versions of xDrip.
evidence_quote: The widget is on it's on home page, maximized to cover the full screen. However, the font doesn't enlarge when the widget size is increased.
